description: Pure enrichment module consuming mcp_tool_schema_patterns.py output. Computes context_efficiency score for MCP servers based on progressive-disclosure vs brute-force enumeration patterns. Expose compute_score(metadata) returning (float, dict). Score progressive-disclosure servers higher. Reads tool_count, pattern type, schema_complexity from metadata. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Must produce >=20 distinct scores. Attribution required: Cloudflare enterprise MCP reference architecture, blog.cloudflare.com, 2026-04-14.
